description: Complete a laboratory requisition for patient Maria Santos (DOB: 1975-08-22). Log in to OSCAR EMR (user: oscardoc, pass: oscar, pin: 1117). Search for the patient and navigate to the Forms section. Open the 'Ontario Lab Requisition' (or generic Lab Requisition) form. Order the following tests: Glucose (fasting), HbA1c, Lipid Profile/Cholesterol, and Creatinine. In the clinical information/notes field, write 'Diabetes follow-up, fasting specimen'.
